caption: The drawing is circular in composition and primarily rendered in shades of brown and purple. Within the circle, there are five human figures depicted. On the left side, a person wearing a helmet or headgear is sitting on a horse, facing right. Directly in front of the horse, two figures are positioned on the ground, one kneeling or crouching with hands raised and the other lying or sitting nearby. To the right, a standing figure holding a large round shield and a staff or spear is positioned near a structure, possibly a building or gate. Above this structure, another figure is visible, appearing to be either standing or leaning over its roof or wall. In the background on the left, there are three pointed tent-like structures set against a landscape with hilly terrain. The sky contains a series of stylized clouds. In the foreground next to the kneeling figure, there is a large round object, possibly a shield or stone, lying on the ground. The image is bordered by a square frame with decorative floral elements at each corner, and there is a small inscription reading "1. SAM. 70. 76." near the lower left side inside the circle.
title: Fireplace Tile
